property_summary: A non-owner who is able to call transferOwnership via the removed-onlyOwner route is still blocked by the programOperators check in create, so the owner-change does not affect mutation of the roundImplementation mapping; after any transferOwnership call that succeeds, the owner of C must be either the new owner (if caller was owner) or remain unchanged (if caller was not owner and call reverted or had no effect) - the bug allows a non-owner to change the owner, violating this invariant.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call transferOwnership, changing ownership and thus the state read by transferOwnership.
